svg.title: XENA LaaS — Technical View v2
svg.desc: Technical architecture with corrections: XENALoader enqueues to SQS grid-queue, GRIDConnector dequeues. OutputHandler Lambda holds StatusTracker and ResultHandler. ProgressTracker is Redis ElastiCache. ErrorHandler is separate Lambda. Observability via GETAFE (Openshift).

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What triggers from xena-input S3 bucket?')
sendPrompt('How does main-queue receive S3 events?')
sendPrompt('Why is grid-queue separate from main-queue in XENA?')
sendPrompt('What is the DLQ used for in XENA?')
sendPrompt('What modules are inside XENALoader Lambda?')
sendPrompt('Why does GRIDConnector only have GRIDInvoker and RetryManager?')
sendPrompt('What does OutputHandler Lambda do with StatusTracker and ResultHandler?')
sendPrompt('What does the ErrorHandler Lambda do in XENA?')
sendPrompt('How does Redis ElastiCache serve as ProgressTracker?')

svg.text: VPC — private subnets · no public ingress

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does GRID runtime execute a library container?')
sendPrompt('What does XDE resolve at execution time?')
sendPrompt('How does the Library Registry work in GRID?')
sendPrompt('How are library containers stored and versioned?')
sendPrompt('How does Kafka stream XENA events to GETAFE?')
sendPrompt('What does Elasticsearch index for XENA?')
